scope.summary: Implement pose_body so natural language, a BodyPose library ref, or a verified PoseLiftProposal produces a canonical BodyPose preview that is validated before explicit selected apply.
acceptance_criteria: Natural-language and library inputs use the canonical MT-520 BodyPose service; verified lift input must be hsk.tailor.pose_lift_proposal@1 with matching binding, body, skeleton, camera, contact, and expected-base hashes.
Every lane returns an immutable preview/diff with IK/contact validation and warnings before an explicit selected apply command; no character-sheet graph or raw PoseKit payload can mutate pose state.

Apply re-solves in morph context, records actor/lease/event/receipt provenance, supports cancellation before commit, and rejects stale, ambiguous, wrong-character, or incompatible proposals atomically.
scope.risk_if_missed: A convenience pose tool that applies unverified model or 2D output directly would bypass the canonical BodyPose proposal and review boundary.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor model manual > pose_body inputs, preview, selected apply, and rejection paths

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Accept BodyPoseAsset or verified PoseKit export through lift/retarget proposal; require preview/validation before apply.
